description: Create a weather- and activity-aware packing checklist for a trip, grouped into sections and saved as a pinned checklist note. Never changes an existing list: if one already exists it is returned unchanged; use packing_list_regenerate to replace it. Requires the trip to have a destination or at least one itinerary item. Provide the trip_id from trips_list. For one list per person, pass people (max 6). Tineo builds the list on its servers with its AI model provider, sending the trip's title, dates, destinations, itinerary items, weather forecast, any context_notes, and each person's age band and notes (never their name).

context_notes.description: Optional packing-relevant details the user asked to include, such as planned activities or special gear. Pass only what the user wants reflected in the list. Never include health conditions, medical details or other sensitive personal information.

people.description: Optional. One personalized list per person (max 6), titled with the person's name.

name.description: Person's name or a label such as "Kid 1". Used only as the list's title; never sent to the AI model provider.

notes.description: Optional packing-relevant details for this person that the user asked to include. Never include health conditions, medical details or other sensitive personal information.

name: generate_packing_list
title: Generate Packing List
